svg.title: Krupakar S Bilichod, with a tree of his work: Zlang, his first own project, Hasfragis, a team project, and BitPillars, his game studio.
svg.text: Cyber security student building tools that make security work simpler and easier to verify.

g.text: A language and console that puts common security tools behind one readable syntax.
Pipelines, scripts, a scope check on every network command, and a tamper-evident log.
A digital forensics toolkit that makes evidence tamper-evident and checkable.
File hashes, a Merkle root, a signed custody ledger and an incident timeline.
Tiny pixel games, free to play in the browser on phone or desktop.
Seven games so far, from a gravity puzzle to a light puzzle. krupakarsb.github.io/bitpillars
